messages:
IncidentBot: Pager | Severity: Sev2 — Elevated 502/504 rate detected at api-gw-prod. Auto-alert triggered, routing & fanout panels spiking. See telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/incidents/8054321999
Maya Chen: Observed sudden 502 spike starting ~10:03 UTC, error rate +40% from edge->gateway. Mostly eu-west mux -> inference pool fanout. Dashboard link pinned.
Jon Patel: I'm on it — pulling traces and ingress proxy logs now. Any recent routing or control-plane changes?
Priya Nair: No config rollouts in control-plane in last 24h. Backend retries and some upstream timeouts increasing around the same time window.
Mateo Ruiz: Looks like a few heavy clients causing fanout amplification. Proposing temporary circuit-quarantine for the offending upstream set while we stabilize.
Mateo Ruiz: Running these to reduce amplification:
```bash
kubectl -n gateway patch deploy/mux --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"ROUTE_QUARANTINE","value":"client-heavy"}}]'
kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/mux
```
Maya Chen: Flipping proxy retry for /v1/infer to 0 to avoid retry amplification across fanout. Will monitor error shape.
Jon Patel: Initiating traffic shift: move ~20% of inbound to fallback pool model-variants-compat and reduce parallel fanout. Command run via routing service, ETA ~2m.
Priya Nair: Customer impact snapshot: ~1.2k req/min failing at peak, top impacted accounts: Acme Corp (high), Nimbus Labs (moderate). CS and account owners notified; CS draft in #customer-impact.
Maya Chen: Enabling short-lived KV prefix caching/warmers for hot prefixes to cut backend load. Applied 30s cache for cold-start prefixes.
Mateo Ruiz: KV caching deployed, metrics show immediate reduction in backend QPS for those prefixes. Latency trending down.
IncidentBot: Reminder — on-call handoff scheduled in 45m to eng-sre-night. Pager follow-up set with current mitigation notes.
Jon Patel: Post-change numbers: 502 rate down from 4.1% to 0.8% across eu-west, overall errors trending to baseline. Keeping 10m watch window.
Priya Nair: Leaving follow-ups: runbook item to audit connection pool sizes and keepalive defaults; add an automated detector for fanout amplification patterns.
Maya Chen: Opening postmortem stub and customer outreach draft: https://docs.redwood/internal/pm-8054321999. Will annotate timeline + mitigation steps.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll coordinate reverting the circuit-quarantine and retry config once stable for 30m. Will confirm before flip. :thumbsup:
